gloss: to come across, to run into, to encounter

definitions.gloss: to come across, to run into
definitions.explanation: To meet someone or encounter something unexpectedly and by chance.
To find oneself in an unexpected situation, often unpleasant.

examples.japanese: {友|とも}だちに{出|で}くわした。
{駅|えき}で{先生|せんせい}に{出|で}くわした。
examples.english: I ran into my teacher at the station.

examples.japanese: {買|か}い{物|もの}の{途中|とちゅう}で{偶然|ぐうぜん}{隣|となり}の{人|ひと}に{出|で}くわした。
examples.english: I happened to run into my neighbor while shopping.

examples.japanese: {海外|かいがい}{旅行|りょこう}で{高校|こうこう}{時代|じだい}の{同級生|どうきゅうせい}に{出|で}くわして{驚|おどろ}いた。
examples.english: I was surprised to run into a high school classmate while traveling abroad.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}を{休|やす}んで{遊|あそ}びに{行|い}ったら、{上司|じょうし}に{出|で}くわしてしまった。
examples.english: I took the day off work to go have fun, but I ran into my boss.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}きな{問題|もんだい}に{出|で}くわした。
{旅行中|りょこうちゅう}に{思|おも}わぬトラブルに{出|で}くわした。
examples.english: I encountered unexpected trouble during my trip.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}で{難|むずか}しい{場面|ばめん}に{出|で}くわすことがある。
examples.english: I sometimes encounter difficult situations at work.

examples.japanese: {初|はじ}めての{海外|かいがい}で{言葉|ことば}が{通|つう}じない{場面|ばめん}に{何度|なんど}も{出|で}くわした。
examples.english: On my first trip abroad, I repeatedly encountered situations where I couldn't make myself understood.

examples.japanese: {長|なが}い{人生|じんせい}の{中|なか}で、{誰|だれ}もが{予想|よそう}もしない{出来事|できごと}に{出|で}くわすものだ。
examples.english: In a long life, everyone encounters events they never expected.

notes:
{出|で}くわす is an intransitive verb ({自動詞|じどうし}) meaning to encounter unexpectedly.

COMPOUND STRUCTURE:
- {出|で}る (to go out) + くわす (to encounter) → to go out and encounter

ASPECT (ている):
{出|で}くわしている is rare; the simple past {出|で}くわした is more common.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {偶然|ぐうぜん}{出|で}くわす (come across by chance)
- ～に{出|で}くわす (run into~)
- トラブルに{出|で}くわす (encounter trouble)
- {思|おも}いがけず{出|で}くわす (unexpectedly run into)

NUANCE:
Implies an unexpected, unplanned encounter. Can be used for both pleasant surprises and awkward situations. More casual than {遭遇|そうぐう}する.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {出会|であ}う: to meet, encounter (more neutral or positive)
- {遭遇|そうぐう}する: to encounter (formal)
- {出|で}くわす often implies surprise or coincidence

[Register: Casual to Neutral]
